# Rida Naz - Full Profile

Rida Naz is a Full Stack Developer and Agentic AI Engineer with 1.5+ years 
of experience building production AI systems based in Karachi, Pakistan.

## Current Role
Founding team member and Lead Engineer at TalkifAI — an early-stage AI voice 
agent platform built from scratch. Responsible for core infrastructure including 
BYOC telephony (Twilio, Telnyx, SIP), LiveKit voice pipeline, multi-tenant 
architecture, and deployment on Google Cloud.

## Technical Stack
Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Google Cloud, LiveKit, SIP/WebRTC,
LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Code, MCP servers

## Specializations
- Voice AI agents and real-time communication
- Agentic workflows and multi-agent systems
- Full stack SaaS platforms
- MCP server integration
- RAG knowledge systems
- Agentic SEO and AI visibility
